subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept this one-way device-identity cutover, including Doctor-required legacy import and the requirement that JSON-only binaries not share a migrated state directory?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the durable owner of Ed25519 key material and explicitly removes a supported downgrade path; code review cannot decide the release and operator-compatibility policy on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Approve the documented cutover
options.body: Accept SQLite as the only runtime owner, require Doctor for legacy JSON import, and document that mixed or downgraded JSON-only binaries must not share the migrated state directory.

options.title: Defer for a staged release plan
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers define a rollout, downgrade, or coordinated-upgrade policy that they are willing to support.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented cutover
recommendation.body: Accept SQLite as the only runtime owner, require Doctor for legacy JSON import, and document that mixed or downgraded JSON-only binaries must not share the migrated state directory.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current migration series and supplied the explicit contract requiring acceptance; a repository owner should make the final release decision.
